configuration.biomarker_selection: A candidate must be a significant human DEG, include at least one additional evidence category, and have at least one cross-dimensional network support category (hub support across at least two centrality metrics, measured network drift, or observed lost/gained interactions). DEG alone, module association alone, and orthology alone do not qualify. Eligible candidates are ordered by evidence-category count, adjusted p-value, and absolute log2 fold change; no composite biomarker score is used.

limitations: Research prioritization only, not a clinical risk estimate.
Human cancer and mouse cancer networks differ substantially in size and density.
Mouse expression is from an independent-study exploratory comparison and is reported but excluded from the score.
Absence of a one-to-one orthology record is not proof of genomic deletion.
Missing evidence is null and excluded from the normalized score; it is not replaced with zero.

biomarkers.selection_basis: A candidate must be a significant human DEG, include at least one additional evidence category, and have at least one cross-dimensional network support category (hub support across at least two centrality metrics, measured network drift, or observed lost/gained interactions). DEG alone, module association alone, and orthology alone do not qualify. Eligible candidates are ordered by evidence-category count, adjusted p-value, and absolute log2 fold change; no composite biomarker score is used.
limitations: Candidates are research-only and have not undergone independent or clinical validation.
Drift and lost/gained interaction evidence derive from related saved network comparisons and are not independent validation.
The human and mouse cancer networks differ substantially in size and density.

hub_genes.method: Within-module arithmetic mean percentile of available degree, weighted degree, betweenness, eigenvector centrality, closeness, and intramodular connectivity; hub-supported when at least two metrics are available and their mean percentile is >= 0.90. Missing metrics are excluded.

pathways.significant_pathway_count_unit: Significant pathway-by-gene-set rows; a pathway can be counted for multiple input gene sets.
pathways.gsea_status: NOT_RUN; invoke with --gsea to run local preranked analysis
limitations: Mouse DEG results compare independent studies and remain exploratory, not matched human-mouse replication.
Reactome results are human-only because no mouse Reactome set was acquired.
Network-edge divergence is highly sensitive to the saved network density imbalance and is not proof of biological edge deletion.
ORA gene universes are database-specific expressed Ensembl genes with an unambiguous local mapping.
Pathway enrichment is hypothesis-generating and is not clinical validation.

provenance.analysis: Local offline over-representation, optional local preranked GSEA, and ortholog-mapped pathway network comparison

GO.version: GO basic ontology snapshot plus gene associations dated 2026-05-21
GO.organism_policy: Separate taxon-filtered human and mouse GAF annotations; ancestor propagation uses is_a and part_of.

Reactome.organism_policy: Human R-HSA pathways only; no mouse Reactome terms are reported.

WikiPathways.organism_policy: Separate Homo sapiens and Mus musculus collections; Entrez IDs map locally to Ensembl.

Ensembl.version: Local whole-gene ID maps; BioMart release is not encoded in the downloaded tables.
Ensembl.organism_policy: Unique Entrez and symbol mappings only for source identifiers; Ensembl stable IDs remain species-specific.

provenance.identifier_policy: No gene identifiers are uploaded. Gene sets and ID conversions are computed from local snapshots. Ambiguous source-symbol/Entrez mappings are excluded rather than guessed.

statistics.ora: Hypergeometric upper-tail test with Benjamini-Hochberg correction over all tested pathways within species, gene set, and database; genes outside the annotated library are excluded from that database's universe.
statistics.gsea: Local gseapy prerank against in-memory local gene sets; 1000 permutations and seed 42 when enabled.

comparison.module_preservation: Maximum Jaccard similarity of ortholog-mapped within-pathway module membership.
comparison.network_edge_drift: 1 - conserved mapped within-pathway edges / union of conserved, lost, and gained mapped edges; undefined for empty unions.
comparison.key_pathway_rule: At least one species has pathway ORA FDR <= 0.05 and the measurable within-pathway mapped edge divergence is greater than zero.

morphology.association_reason: Clinical pathology fields are linked to only 8 human tumor samples in this run; no inferential morphology-to-gene association is reported. No pathology images or validated image-derived features are present.
morphology.interpretation: The morphology field is an ICD-O clinical pathology code, not a measured image feature. Counts are descriptive only.

ppi.reason: No run-wide, versioned PPI reference network was acquired for this run. Co-expression edges are not treated as PPI evidence.

provenance.mouse_expression_design: Exploratory cross-study comparison; not matched-control evidence.
